description: JPMorgan Chase & Co., a financial holding company incorporated under Delaware law in 1968, is a leading financial services firm based in the United States with operations worldwide, and it had $4.4 trillion in assets and $362.4 billion in stockholders' equity as of December 31, 2025. The Firm is a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management, and under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands it serves millions of customers, predominantly in the U.S., and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients globally. Its principal bank subsidiary is JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, a national banking association with U.S. branches in 48 states and Washington, D.C., and its principal non-bank subsidiary is J.P. Morgan Securities LLC.
